model_contract.candidate: Add a side-specific ridge prediction of the baseline's five-year RAPM residual using only pooled leave-one-player-out teammate context.
model_contract.context_window: Possession-weight annual context over the identical five seasons as the baseline rating.
model_contract.chronology: For rating season t, fit the residual correction only on stored predictions with window ends earlier than t.
model_contract.sample_weight: Square root of the smaller five-year target possession exposure.

selection_rule: Choose offense and defense correction penalties on the 2024 rating, then freeze them for 2025 and 2026.
primary_comparison: Matched-player next-season one-year RAPM RMSE and correlation for 2024-to-2025 and 2025-to-2026.
secondary_comparison: Same-window five-year RAPM residual fit in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
stopping_rules: Do not change context fields or penalties after inspecting 2024.
Do not treat same-team context as player skill or a causal teammate effect.
Do not promote from inspected 2025 or reused 2026 evidence.
